title: delphinium menziesii subsp. ochroleucum
intro: Delphinium menziesii subsp. ochroleucum, commonly known as Menzies' delphinium or Mountain Delphinium, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the western coast of North America. The health benefits of Menzies' delphinium include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include delphinine, a compound that has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
